2609.23333.title: A Patient World Model for Early Forecasting of Digital Health Campaign Outcomes: Capabilities and Limits
2609.23333.paper_summary: Digital direct-to-consumer (DTC) health campaigns are usually measured after the fact. In-flight forecasting commonly relies on a separate classifier for every cutoff and horizon. We treat this task as a dynamic-system problem and build a compact patient world model. The architecture maintains a latent state per patient, learns exposure-conditioned state dynamics jointly with a weekly conversion hazard, and rolls forward into future conversion curves. We evaluate it on a US campaign dataset with 147{,}173 patients and 5.2 million at-risk person-weeks. In a retrospective evaluation conditioned on recorded future exposures, the model forecasts the remaining new-to-brand prescription volume through week 52 with a relative error of 2.9\% from a week-4 cutoff and 0.8--2.6\% from cutoffs at weeks 8--26. The strongest non-recurrent baseline, a pooled-hazard gradient boosting model given the same survival rollout and information, has relative errors of 13.6--33.1\%. Per-horizon classifiers perform substantially worse. A Fisher-information analysis motivates dense next-exposure supervision when conversions are rare. Removing this auxiliary objective increases prescription-volume error by approximately $2$--$14\times$, while providing no consistent disadvantage on the more common specialist-visit outcome. We also evaluate scenario simulation. Switching all future exposure off raises predicted conversion from 0.31 to 0.89, a pattern consistent with selection effects in observational exposure data. This result highlights the limits of interpreting exposure-conditioned rollouts causally.
2609.23333.paper_summary_zh: 數位直接面向消費者（DTC）健康宣傳活動通常是在事後進行測量。飛行預測通常依賴於每個截止點和預測範圍的單獨分類器。我們將這項任務視為一個動態系統問題，並建立了一個緊湊的患者世界模型。該架構為每位患者維持一個潛在狀態，並與每週轉換危險共同學習曝光條件下的狀態動態，並向未來的轉換曲線滾進。我們在一個包含147,173名患者和520萬風險人週的美國宣傳活動數據集上進行評估。在基於記錄的未來曝光的回顧性評估中，該模型預測第52週的剩餘新品牌處方量，從第4週截止點的相對誤差為2.9%，從第8至26週的截止點的相對誤差為0.8--2.6%。最強的非重複基準，即在相同生存展開和信息下的合併危險梯度提升模型，其相對誤差為13.6--33.1%。每個預測範圍的分類器表現明顯較差。費雪信息分析促使在轉換稀少時進行密集的下一次曝光監督。移除這一輔助目標會使處方量的誤差增加約$2$--$14\times$，同時對更常見的專科就診結果沒有提供一致的劣勢。我們還評估了情境模擬。關閉所有未來曝光的預測轉換從0.31提高到0.89，這一模式與觀察性曝光數據中的選擇效應一致。這一結果突顯了解釋曝光條件下的展開因果關係的限制。
